info.title: Backend Starter Kit API - Go
info.description: Shared API contract implemented by every framework folder in this repository. All responses use the envelope `{ success, message, data }`; collections add `meta: { page, limit, total, total_pages }`; errors use `{ success: false, message, errors? }`. The `password` field is never returned.
